# waroom_postmortem_template (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom postmortem template. Look the template up by exactly one of `uuid` or `title`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a postmortem template by title.
data "waroom_postmortem_template" "example" {
  title = "Default postmortem"
}

# Or by UUID.
data "waroom_postmortem_template" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `title` (String) The title of the postmortem template. Exactly one of `uuid` or `title` must be set. When looking up by title, the title must match exactly one template.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the postmortem template. Exactly one of `uuid` or `title` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `blob` (String) The content of the postmortem template, in Markdown.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC 3339) when the postmortem template was created.
- `id` (String) Postmortem template ID. This is an alias for `uuid`.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC 3339) when the postmortem template was last updated.
